aapl.text: Apple fell 41.5% in pounds from Dec 2007 to Dec 2008 and regained its previous high 20 months after that peak.

nvda.text: Nvidia fell 72.5% in pounds from Sep 2007 to Nov 2008, leaving £10,000 invested at the high worth £2,750 at the low.

iglt.text: The UK government bond fund fell 31.9% from May 2020 to Oct 2023 and remained 26.8% below that high in Sep 2026.

azn.text: AstraZeneca fell 41.0% from Aug 2006 to Mar 2008 and regained its previous high 43 months after the fall began.

btc.text: Bitcoin’s volatility was 72.2% a year in pounds, and it fell 74.2% from Dec 2017 to Jan 2019.

sgln.text: Physical gold ETC had annual volatility of 16.9% and fell 38.2% in pounds from Aug 2011 to Jul 2015.
